rows.candidate_origin: R390 fresh full-universe diverse cluster / candidate universe rank 214
collapse_regions: dense support + shrinkage=0 -> SACPS covariance equals raw covariance removal control
rows.evidence_boundary: deterministic synthetic mechanism evidence only; no empirical forecasting, trading, deployment or novel-theory claim
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same DLEW shell with raw sample covariance substituted for SACPS covariance

nearest_existing_products.difference: also injects SACPS covariance into a risk objective, but learns a constrained continuous portfolio policy; SACDLW does not learn a policy and instead changes retrospective finite-action model selection/regret inside DLEW
changes DLEW selection over a channel-tipping ambiguity set; SACDLW changes within-regime finite-action risk geometry from covariance support
changes which candidate models are admissible through closure/fidelity certification; SACDLW keeps the candidate set and changes the action/regret geometry

rows.new_failure_mode: DLEW can select a prediction model and finite action sequence using a risk geometry contaminated by finite-sample covariance edges that contradict declared dependency support.
rows.non_additive_interaction: SACPS covariance enters DLEW before argmax action selection and therefore changes the induced action path, oracle comparison, training model ranking, and validation decision regret rather than appending a covariance report.
rows.sensitivity_boundary: benefit is not universal across random shells; strong nuisance cells are favorable on average but contain losing seeds, so candidate must expose its working/failure region rather than claim dominance
rows.support_boundary: support remains externally declared; held-out calibration contradiction abstains rather than silently learning/editing support
rows.working_region: declared support is correct, a small separate risk-estimation sample contains strong unsupported covariance nuisance, and risk aversion makes finite-action DLEW decisions sensitive to that nuisance

rules: visibility expansion is not itself product promotion
executable suite does not imply distinct family
new failure + non-additive interaction + nearest-family comparison + mechanism-removal control required
internal distinct-family accounting does not imply novel theory or external empirical validation
mechanics telemetry calibrates executable contracts only
current test signature, not an older pilot signature, controls calibration authority
